title: Appu & Friends
desc: 'Appu and Friends' is a journey in a forest where animals live as one happy family. We see elephant Appu and friends explore, solve problems and learn friendship and teamwork all together.

title: Hoota & Snoz - The Fun Duo
desc: 'Hoota and Snoz are two cute, long-nosed siblings who are always in a state of rivalry. Whether at breakfast, in the bath, or watching TV, Hoota is usually the instigator of their bickering.'

title: Nori-The Rollercoaster Ride
desc: Nori lives in the famous amusement park, he wants to be like his father Dragon rider, the star of rollercoasters, and a hero. One evil villain Vegas appears, who wants to turn it into his own park.

desc: Christopher Columbus wants to become a sailor. He decides to go to Lisbon in order to learn about marine science. His biggest wish is to enter the School of Navigation at the capital city.
